text:
anya (PM): Quick sync — we need to decide auth model for the next API release. Customers are asking for per-project delegated credentials + clear rotation semantics. Who's available?

mike (eng-platform): Scoped tokens with TTL + optional KMS binding sounds right. Tradeoffs: long-lived chat sessions and cache invalidation on rotation. Need token versioning.

priya (security): Strong preference for short TTLs for delegated tokens, rotation first-class. Migration for existing API keys is mandatory. Also require KMS/HSM integration and audit hooks.

ben (eng-runtime): Rotation impact on KV/prefix caching is big — caches keyed by token identity. Suggest adding a token-version header to avoid breaking sessions: 
```
Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
X-Token-Version: v2
```
Keep token alias mapping for lookup during grace period.

sara (devex): SDK ergonomics: need wrappers like .withProjectKey(projectId, opts) and an automatic refresh flow that retries on 401. Docs should include migration examples and a small code sample: 
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: projectKey });
await client.chat.withProjectKey("project-123").send(...);
```

carlos (customer-success): Note from FinServ pilot: they need per-project billing + the ability to disallow function/tool-calls for delegated tokens. Also cannot tolerate downtime if a rotation invalidates tool ACLs mid-session.

anya (PM): Proposed launch criteria: security sign-off, e2e pass on Hosted/Dedicated/Private, migration guide, SDK updates, and a feature-flagged canary rollout. Prioritize enterprise customers first (Dedicated/Private) then hosted in 2 sprints. :thumbsup:

mike (eng-platform): Implementation outline: auth service changes (token issuance + revocation), policy engine, SDK changes, rollout gating. Rough ETA: 4w engineering + 2w QA + docs. :eyes:

priya (security): Also require backward-compatible aliasing: tokens should map to project IDs for at least 90 days. Rotation endpoint should support nonce exchange to allow long-lived sessions to rekey without interruption.

anya (PM): Action items: mike to write RFC + initial PR, priya to draft security checklist, sara to outline SDK migration guide, carlos to collect customer hard constraints. Sync tomorrow 09:00. :calendar:
